facts.fact: WHO's South Sudan knowledge series (September 2026) reports the Digital Care Companion, a clinical decision support system on symbolic AI, logging 3,168 patient visits across 12 facilities in 10 States and Administrative Areas, with clinicians accepting its diagnosis recommendations.
WHO reports 64.9% of the Digital Care Companion's diagnosis recommendations were accepted by clinicians and 95.0% of 3,168 logged consultations were completed through all nine steps.
